item.title: American Family’s annual revenue dipped 2.5% in 2025
item.description: Madison-based American Family Insurance reported annual revenue of $19.5 billion in 2025, a 2.5% decline from $20 billion in 2024. item.title: Mayville Engineering sees surging data center demand, secures $15 million in new orders
item.description: Mayville Engineering secured $15 million in new data center project awards and now has more than $125 million in pipeline opportunities.
